name: Coaching
description: The 3-month Body & Soul Program — daily tracking, coaching, and communication for clients who have downloaded the program. Layers on top of the membership plugin (fixed-term access) and integrates with booking's follow-up service. Wave 1 ships profile + goals foundation. Wave 2 adds food diary (meals, foods with manual classification, photos), hydration log, physical activity, emotion tracking with hunger/satiety context, and a practitioner-side live feed. Later waves add charts, in-app chat, meal structure, shopping list, recipes, motivation and end-of-program summary.
author: Kohevo
